text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Cityyyy! What in the world is that?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What's, um, that tiny, round little tin?! 
The one that's super sparkly...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's lip balm. Um, it's your birthday 
today, right? I thought it'd make a nice 
present.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, somethin' like that... wasn't it 
crazy expensive?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah—... sorry. My stylist recommended it as 
a good one, so I just kinda... Did it 
bother you?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: No, wait, that's why I'm sayin'...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Going out of your way to get a present for 
me makes me suuuuper mega happy, for 
real!!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still, that aside, are you really sure you 
should be buying someone like me something 
so nice?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So now I'm feeling all sorts of emotions 
at once! What am I supposed to do with all 
this?! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu, ahaha. You have great reactions, 
Tamamo-senpai."
